long_biography.plain_text:
Gökçe entered the sea trade at seventeen and moved into professional command in 1995 after learning aboard a family craft. The enterprise traces its charter activity to Duran Gökçe's 1989 Bozburun build. Birol later became the registered operator of Şahinoğlu Tekne İşletmesi and the firm's industry representative.

His progression from captain to working proprietor culminated in commissioning and supervising a purpose-built guest vessel, then taking the helm in service. The project joined local wooden-boat traditions with a commercial model serving travellers from abroad across Turkey's Aegean and Mediterranean coast. Gökçe's role spans design oversight, ownership, crew leadership and hospitality delivery, making operating responsibility—not passive asset holding—the defining feature of his career.
